title: Expanding fare-free bus passes
summary: Bill 95 writes the new FY27 bus fares into county code, expands fare-free pass eligibility and allows up to 14 fare-free days, at about $2,806 in lost fares per free day. The council advanced it 8–0 on first reading on July 24. The transportation director said federal rules mean free regular routes would also make paratransit free.

timeline.text: Bill 95 expands the county's fare-free bus pass program.
The director said fare-free day notices would go to the council chair by a letter through the mayor's office.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: The committee chair said making buses free for everyone would be discussed later as the program rolls out.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: The director said federal funding rules mean free regular bus routes would also make paratransit, the ADA ride service, free.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: If the bill moves forward, the director said the department would need an updated talk with MEO about the fare-free application process.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: He estimated the County would not collect about $2,806 in fares for each free day.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: He named the Maui County Fair and Earth Day as possible free-ride days.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: New bus fares in the fiscal year 2027 budget took effect the day before, and Bill 95 would write them into County code.
timeline.body: County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee

timeline.text: The committee's only agenda item was Bill 95.
